definitions.explanation: Money or a possession that someone guards carefully and is very reluctant to part with, like a tiger guarding its cub.

examples.japanese: {虎|とら}の{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{虎|とら}の{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{百万円|ひゃくまんえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: I lost the million yen I had been guarding so carefully.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{虎|とら}の{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一点|いってん}→一点：08894_itten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{守|まも}り→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}いて→抜く：02384_nuku⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}した→優勝する：25496_yuushousuru⟧。
examples.english: The team held on to its precious one-point lead to the end and won the championship.

notes:
Most often used of money ({虎|とら}の{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧) and, in sports reporting, of a narrow lead that must be protected ({虎|とら}の{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一点|いってん}→一点：08894_itten⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {虎|とら}の{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧: one's precious savings
- {虎|とら}の{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一点|いってん}→一点：08894_itten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect a precious one-run (one-goal) lead
- {虎|とら}の{子|こ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はたく: to spend one's treasured savings
